docs.title: Astana - capital of Kazakhstan
paragraphs: Astana is the capital city of Kazakhstan. It has been the capital since 1997, when the seat of government moved from Almaty.
The city was named Nur-Sultan from 2019 to 2022 and was renamed back to Astana in September 2022.
Almaty remains the largest city in Kazakhstan and its main commercial centre.

docs.title: Астана — столица Казахстана
paragraphs: Астана является столицей Республики Казахстан с 1997 года, когда столица была перенесена из Алматы.
С 2019 по 2022 год город назывался Нур-Султан, в сентябре 2022 года ему вернули название Астана.
Алматы остаётся крупнейшим городом страны.

docs.title: Астана — Қазақстанның астанасы
paragraphs: Астана 1997 жылдан бері Қазақстан Республикасының астанасы болып табылады.
Қала 2019 жылдан 2022 жылға дейін Нұр-Сұлтан деп аталды, 2022 жылдың қыркүйегінде қайтадан Астана атауы берілді.
Алматы — елдің ең үлкен қаласы.

docs.title: Mount Everest height
paragraphs: Mount Everest is 8,849 metres (29,032 feet) above sea level, according to the joint survey by China and Nepal announced in December 2020.
Earlier official figures were 8,848 metres from Nepal's 1955 survey and 8,844.43 metres from a 2005 Chinese survey that measured rock height.

docs.title: Apollo 11 Moon landing
paragraphs: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon on July 20, 1969. Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed the lunar module Eagle while Michael Collins orbited in Columbia.
Armstrong stepped onto the lunar surface about six hours after landing, on July 21, 1969 UTC.

docs.title: War and Peace (novel)
paragraphs: War and Peace is a novel by the Russian author Leo Tolstoy, published in serial form from 1865 and in full in 1869.
It follows several aristocratic families through the Napoleonic era, including the French invasion of Russia in 1812.

docs.title: Boiling point of water
paragraphs: At standard sea-level pressure (1 atmosphere), pure water boils at 100 degrees Celsius, which is 212 degrees Fahrenheit.
At higher altitude the air pressure is lower, so water boils at a lower temperature.

docs.title: systemd user services - ArchWiki-style guide
paragraphs: A user service is enabled with systemctl --user enable name.service and started with systemctl --user start name.service.
User services normally start when the user logs in. To start them at boot and keep them running after logout, enable lingering with loginctl enable-linger username.
User unit files live in ~/.config/systemd/user/.

docs.title: Checking the NVIDIA driver version on Linux
paragraphs: Run nvidia-smi in a terminal: the header shows the installed NVIDIA driver version and the highest CUDA version it supports.
You can also read /proc/driver/nvidia/version, or run modinfo nvidia to see the kernel module's version.

docs.title: Python global interpreter lock (GIL)
paragraphs: The global interpreter lock (GIL) in CPython is a mutex that allows only one thread to execute Python bytecode at a time.
The GIL simplifies memory management but limits CPU-bound multithreading; I/O-bound threads release it while waiting.
PEP 703 added an optional free-threaded build of CPython, first shipped as experimental in Python 3.13, in which the GIL can be disabled.

docs.title: PEP 703 - Making the Global Interpreter Lock Optional in CPython
paragraphs: PEP 703 proposes adding a build configuration (--disable-gil) to CPython so that it can run Python code without the global interpreter lock.
The free-threaded build has a single-threaded performance overhead; the PEP and later release notes describe it as experimental in Python 3.13.
Multi-threaded CPU-bound programs can scale across cores in the free-threaded build, but C extensions must be updated to be thread-safe.

docs.title: SearXNG settings.yml reference
paragraphs: In SearXNG's default settings.yml the server section sets port: 8888 and bind_address: 127.0.0.1.
The limiter protects public instances from bots; it should be enabled on any instance reachable from the internet.
The json output format must be listed under search.formats before API clients can request format=json.

docs.title: SearXNG limiter and bot detection
paragraphs: The limiter is SearXNG's bot protection. Public instances should run it, because engines such as Google and Bing block instances that send automated traffic.
Without the limiter, a public instance can be abused and get its IP address banned by upstream search engines.
A private instance bound to 127.0.0.1 does not need the limiter.

docs.title: git rebase documentation
paragraphs: git rebase reapplies commits on top of another base tip, producing a linear history.
Interactive rebase (git rebase -i) lets you reorder, squash, edit or drop commits.
Do not rebase commits that others have already pulled from a shared branch.

docs.title: Fix 'Permission denied' when running a script on Linux
paragraphs: The error appears when the file lacks the execute permission. Add it with chmod +x script.sh and run it as ./script.sh.
If the file system is mounted with noexec, run the script through its interpreter instead, for example bash script.sh.

docs.title: TCP vs UDP
paragraphs: TCP is connection-oriented and guarantees ordered, reliable delivery with retransmission and congestion control.
UDP is connectionless: it sends datagrams without delivery or ordering guarantees, which gives lower latency and overhead.
Streaming, games and DNS often use UDP, while web pages, e-mail and file transfer use TCP.

docs.title: Wayland vs X11
paragraphs: In Wayland the compositor is also the display server, while X11 separates the X server from the window manager and compositor.
Wayland isolates clients from each other, so one application cannot read another's input or screen contents by default; X11 allows that.
X11 applications run on Wayland through XWayland.

docs.title: SQLite or PostgreSQL for a desktop application
paragraphs: SQLite is an embedded database stored in a single file and needs no server, which suits desktop applications.
PostgreSQL is a client-server database with stronger concurrent write support, roles and network access, suited to multi-user servers.
For a single-user desktop app SQLite is usually the simpler choice.

Orion-7 supports a context window of 512,000 tokens and is available through the company's API from today.
The company said Orion-7 replaces Orion-6, which was released eleven months ago.

docs.title: Mercury (planet)
paragraphs: Mercury is the smallest planet in the Solar System and the closest to the Sun, orbiting it every 88 days.

docs.title: Mercury (element)
paragraphs: Mercury is a chemical element with symbol Hg and atomic number 80, the only metal that is liquid at room temperature.

paragraphs: Glacier archive retrievals take between one minute and twelve hours depending on the tier.

docs.title: Transport layer: TCP and UDP compared
paragraphs: TCP sets up a connection with a three-way handshake before data flows; UDP sends without a handshake.
Because UDP skips acknowledgements and retransmission, it suits real-time traffic such as voice and games where late data is useless.

docs.title: Why desktops moved from X11 to Wayland
paragraphs: X11's network-transparent design lets any client read the screen and other windows' input, which Wayland's protocol does not allow.
Under Wayland the compositor handles rendering, input and window management in one process.

docs.title: When to use SQLite
paragraphs: SQLite works well as the on-disk file format for desktop and mobile applications, with no server to install or administer.
Client-server databases such as PostgreSQL are the better fit when many users write concurrently over a network.
